entries.evidence: Q2 2026 revenue $9.56B; common net income $451.4M; Q2 CFO about $1.1B; Q2 FCF about $0.9B; June RPO $33.55B and total backlog $53.44B; FY2026 revenue guide raised to $39.3B-$39.7B and company-defined FCF guide to $2.0B-$2.5B.

RPO $33.554B, 70% expected within 12 months. Backlog $53.440B additionally includes estimated MSA orders, estimated renewals and certain non-fixed-price contracts. RPO timing can change from cancellations, delays, regulatory and commercial issues.

H1 2026 revenue $17.432B vs $13.006B; common net income $672.0M vs $373.5M; CFO $1.487B vs $0.539B; capex $451.0M vs $273.1M; non-cash SBC $126.0M vs $82.2M. Electric H1 revenue $14.306B and operating income $1.459B.

June 2026 DSO 57 days vs 62 days June 2025 and below five-year average 71. Cash flow is affected by receivables, contract assets/liabilities and change orders/claims; Canadian renewable transmission change orders/claims negatively affected DSO/cash flow.
June cash $506.4M. Long-term debt obligations $6.096B including current maturities; commercial paper $448M and revolving loans $28.9M. Cash plus available senior-credit commitments about $2.766B.
No customer represented 10% or more of consolidated revenue in Q2/H1 2026 or 2025, and no customer represented 10% or more of consolidated receivables at June 2026 or December 2025.

PwC opined 2025 financial statements fairly presented and ICFR effective. Eight 2025 acquisitions totaling 6.2% of assets and 3.9% of revenue were excluded from 2025 ICFR assessment/audit under SEC acquisition guidance and were being integrated.

About 63.8% of 2025 revenue used over-time percentage-of-completion accounting. At year-end 2025 Quanta recognized $983.6M of revenue associated with unapproved change orders and claims being negotiated, making project-estimate and collection discipline material.

Phalcon, Percheron and PSD were acquired in Q2 and Enerfab in July. Aggregate upfront consideration net of cash acquired was about $1.24B, including about $1.07B cash and $173.3M stock, plus up to $242.3M contingent consideration. 2026 contribution guidance from these acquisitions was $1.2B-$1.4B revenue and $120M-$140M adjusted EBITDA.
FY2025 revenue $28.48B, common net income $1.028B, CFO $2.230B, capex $609.2M, non-cash SBC $181.9M and acquisition cash spending about $3.05B.
TTM revenue $32.906B; common net income $1.327B; CFO $3.178B; capex $0.787B; OCF-capex $2.391B; SBC $0.226B; OCF-capex-SBC diagnostic $2.165B.

9% hurdle scenarios: Bear ~$118.96, Base ~$479.64, Bull ~$1,094.14. Under retained Base margin/terminal assumptions, $618.73 requires ~11.86% annual revenue growth for years 2-10 after $39.5B year-1 revenue.
